items.title: Medicare Just Locked In Most of Your 2027 Costs. One Big Number Is Still Missing
items.summary: Medicare open enrollment ends Dec. 7, and most 2027 costs are set: a $2,400 Part D cap, a $700 deductible and a 3.6% COLA. For a 72-year-old with one costly drug, the bill rises $300, her check nets about $76 more a month, and a plan comparison is worth $408.
